title: Canonical small etale geometric morphism of an algebraic-space map
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and sheaves on their small and enlarged etale sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. For a morphism $f:X\to Y$, define $f_*:\operatorname{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}})\to\operatorname{Sh}(Y_{\mathrm{et}})$ by extending to the enlarged site, evaluating on base changes, and restricting to scheme objects. Use the geometric morphism with this specified direct image supplied by the enlarged-site model. Its inverse image $f^{-1}$ is the left adjoint, with its actual unit and counit; all choices are identified by the unique adjunction-compatible isomorphism. Set coefficients range over the chosen universe $\operatorname{Type}(\max(u+1,w))$. This defines a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism], not a conservativity or descent assertion.
